mod.toolmastery.name: Tool Mastery
screen.toolmastery.title: Tool Mastery
screen.toolmastery.coming_soon_badge: ★ COMING SOON — planned for a future update
screen.toolmastery.enchant_needs_unlock: Unlock this node before you can enchant with it.
screen.toolmastery.unlock_needs_tier: Tier %s is still locked — unlock the tier first.
screen.toolmastery.unlock_needs_node: Unlock %s first — ranks are bought in order.
screen.toolmastery.tier_needs_previous: Tiers open in order — unlock tier %s first.
screen.toolmastery.confirm.tier_body: Spends %s XP levels and opens every node of this tier for unlocking. The gate you completed stays completed.
screen.toolmastery.confirm.unlock_body_p: Spends the levels and the materials listed above, once. %1$s switches on the moment it is unlocked — there is no second step and nothing to apply to a tool.
screen.toolmastery.confirm.unlock_body_e: Spends the levels and the materials listed above, once. From now on %1$s can turn up in your enchanting table offers, and the Enchant button stamps it straight onto the item in your hand for %2$s levels, as many times as you like.
screen.toolmastery.confirm.unlock_body_c: Spends the levels and the materials listed above, once. %1$s never rolls at an enchanting table, so the Enchant button is the only way onto a tool — %2$s levels a time, as many times as you like.
screen.toolmastery.confirm.enchant_body: Spends whole XP levels and enchants the item in your main hand. Repeatable on any compatible item. It is priced above the enchanting table on purpose: the table is the cheaper route, this is the guaranteed one.
screen.toolmastery.help: Click a node to see its details. Unlock buys it once with XP levels plus materials; passives start working straight away and enchantments join your enchanting table. Enchant then stamps an unlocked enchantment on the item in your hand, as often as you like. Click a tier header (T1-T5) for its gate achievements.
enchant.toolmastery.fail.empty_hand: Hold the tool you want to give %s to in your main hand.
enchant.toolmastery.fail.unsupported: A %1$s cannot take %2$s — that enchantment belongs on a different kind of tool.
mastery.toolmastery.fail.levels: Not enough XP: %1$s levels needed, you have %2$s.
mastery.toolmastery.tier.fail.complete: Every tier of this tree is already unlocked.
mastery.toolmastery.unlock.fail.future: %s is coming in a future update and cannot be unlocked yet.
mastery.toolmastery.unlock.ok.passive: %s unlocked — the passive is live right now.
mastery.toolmastery.unlock.ok.enchantmen: %1$s unlocked! It can roll at your enchanting table from now on, and the skill screen stamps it on the item in your hand for %2$s levels.
mastery.toolmastery.unlock.ok.capstone: %1$s unlocked! It never rolls at a table — stamp it on the item in your hand from the skill screen for %2$s levels.
mastery.toolmastery.enchant.fail.not_enc: %s has nothing to stamp on a tool.
mastery.toolmastery.enchant.fail.locked: Unlock %s before you can enchant with it.
mastery.toolmastery.tier.unlocked: Unlocked %1$s node(s) for tier %2$s of '%3$s' (%4$s skipped: coming soon, or the other half of a capstone pair).
mastery.toolmastery.tier.fail.range: Tier count must be between 0 and %s.
mastery.toolmastery.tier.set: Tree '%1$s' now has %2$s tier(s) unlocked; nodes above that were re-locked.
mastery.toolmastery.lock.fail.not_owned: %s is not unlocked, so there is nothing to lock.
mastery.toolmastery.strip.fail.empty: Hold the item you want stripped in your main hand.
mastery.toolmastery.strip.ok: Removed %1$s Tool Mastery enchantment(s) from your %2$s.
advancements.toolmastery.root.title: Tool Mastery
advancements.toolmastery.root.descriptio: Master a tool class: complete its tier gates, then spend XP levels to unlock the tier.
Unlock tier 1 of the Pickaxe tree — Path of the Deep.
Unlock tier 2 of the Pickaxe tree — Path of the Deep.
Unlock tier 3 of the Pickaxe tree — Path of the Deep.
Unlock tier 4 of the Pickaxe tree — Path of the Deep.
Unlock the final tier of the Pickaxe tree and claim its capstone.
advancements.toolmastery.axe.tier_1.desc: Unlock tier 1 of the Axe tree — Path of the Grove.
advancements.toolmastery.axe.tier_2.desc: Unlock tier 2 of the Axe tree — Path of the Grove.
advancements.toolmastery.axe.tier_3.desc: Unlock tier 3 of the Axe tree — Path of the Grove.
advancements.toolmastery.axe.tier_4.desc: Unlock tier 4 of the Axe tree — Path of the Grove.
advancements.toolmastery.axe.tier_5.desc: Unlock the final tier of the Axe tree and claim its capstone.
advancements.toolmastery.enchanter.tier_: Unlock tier 1 of the Enchanter tree — Path of the Arcane.
Unlock tier 2 of the Enchanter tree — Path of the Arcane.
Unlock tier 3 of the Enchanter tree — Path of the Arcane.
Unlock tier 4 of the Enchanter tree — Path of the Arcane.
Unlock the final tier of the Enchanter tree and claim its capstone.
node.toolmastery.masons_grip_1.desc: Passive: mine stone, deepslate and ores 20% faster with a pickaxe.
node.toolmastery.masons_grip_2.desc: Passive: raises the stone, deepslate and ore bonus to 40%.
node.toolmastery.masons_grip_3.desc: Passive: raises the stone, deepslate and ore bonus to 60%.
node.toolmastery.miners_magnet.desc: Passive: drops from blocks broken with a pickaxe go straight into your inventory instead of landing on the ground — the extras from Dig Range and Rich Vein included, and whatever Smelt already smelted. Anything that does not fit is left where it fell.
node.toolmastery.smelt_1.desc: Enchantment: each raw ore you mine has a 25% chance to come out already smelted.
node.toolmastery.smelt_2.desc: Enchantment: raises the smelt chance to 50%.
node.toolmastery.smelt_3.desc: Enchantment: raises the smelt chance to 100% — every raw ore drops as an ingot.
node.toolmastery.dig_range_1.desc: Enchantment: breaking a block also breaks the one directly below it. Only pickaxe-mineable blocks of about the same hardness. Sneak to disable.
node.toolmastery.dig_range_2.desc: Enchantment: widens the break to a cross on the plane you are facing — 4 blocks around the one you hit, no corners.
node.toolmastery.dig_range_3.desc: Enchantment: widens the break to a full 3x3 on the plane you are facing.
node.toolmastery.miners_helm.desc: Unlocks the recipe for a helmet that grants night vision deep underground.
node.toolmastery.rich_vein_1.desc: Enchantment: breaking an ore breaks the connected ores of the same kind with it, up to 8. Sneak to disable.
node.toolmastery.rich_vein_2.desc: Enchantment: raises the vein limit to 16 ores.
node.toolmastery.deep_haste.desc: Passive: permanent Haste I while you are below Y = 0. Never overrides a stronger Haste from a beacon or a potion.
node.toolmastery.obsidian_breaker.desc: Passive: obsidian and crying obsidian break 50% faster with a pickaxe.
node.toolmastery.ancient_fortune.desc: Capstone passive: lifts the ceiling on vanilla Fortune from III to IV. Your enchanting table can offer Fortune IV from now on — nobody else's can.
node.toolmastery.lumberjacks_arms_1.desc: Passive: chop wood 25% faster with an axe.
node.toolmastery.lumberjacks_arms_2.desc: Passive: raises the chopping bonus to 50%.
node.toolmastery.lumberjacks_arms_3.desc: Passive: raises the chopping bonus to 75%.
node.toolmastery.loggers_magnet.desc: Passive: blocks chopped with an axe drop straight into your inventory, Logic fells included. Anything that does not fit stays on the ground.
node.toolmastery.fair_harvest.desc: Passive: +25% sapling drop chance from every leaf block you break, on top of the vanilla roll.
node.toolmastery.logic_1.desc: Enchantment: breaking one log fells the whole tree, log by log. The tree needs leaves, so log houses are safe. Chopping is slower while you carry only this level. Sneak to disable.
node.toolmastery.logic_2.desc: Enchantment: the whole tree falls at once, and the chopping penalty is gone.
node.toolmastery.logic_3.desc: Enchantment: the fell clears the canopy too — leaves come down with the trunk.
node.toolmastery.rich_bark.desc: Stripping logs drops Bark — a light fuel and compostable item.
node.toolmastery.pruner.desc: Passive: leaves broken with an axe drop double loot — apples, saplings and sticks alike.
node.toolmastery.double_axe_1.desc: Passive: each log you chop has a 10% chance to drop twice. Every log of a Logic fell rolls on its own.
node.toolmastery.double_axe_2.desc: Passive: raises the double-drop chance to 20%.
node.toolmastery.shield_breaker.desc: Passive: your axes disable a blocking shield for 2 extra seconds and push 2 more damage through it.
node.toolmastery.environment.desc: Enchantment: a tree felled with Logic III replants its sapling on the stump, taking one from your inventory.
node.toolmastery.green_heart.desc: Capstone: replanted saplings may grow instantly; Pruner gains Fortune.
node.toolmastery.arcane_insight_1.desc: Passive: a panel beside the enchanting table reveals the true enchantments behind the first offer, before you pay for it.
node.toolmastery.arcane_insight_2.desc: Passive: the panel also reveals the second offer.
node.toolmastery.arcane_insight_3.desc: Passive: the panel reveals all three offers.
node.toolmastery.scholar_1.desc: Passive: +20% XP from every source — orbs, smelting, breeding, bottles.
node.toolmastery.scholar_2.desc: Passive: raises the XP bonus to 40%.
node.toolmastery.scholar_3.desc: Passive: raises the XP bonus to 60%.
node.toolmastery.book_binder.desc: Crafting books and bookshelves has a 50% chance to refund one ingredient.
node.toolmastery.tome_keeper.desc: Unlocks the recipe for the Arcane Tome — a portable library that stores your enchanted books.
node.toolmastery.inner_focus.desc: Passive: enchanting no longer requires or consumes lapis lazuli — your focus channels the table directly.
node.toolmastery.indestructible.desc: Enchantment: the item never breaks. Damage stops one point short, like an Elytra. While it sits there spent it works like an empty hand — bare-hand digging speed, and blocks that need a tool drop nothing — until you repair it.
node.toolmastery.anvil_adept.desc: Anvil repairs and merges cost 30% fewer levels and never become 'Too Expensive'.
node.toolmastery.arcane_conduit.desc: Your enchanting table reaches full power with half the bookshelves.
node.toolmastery.ancient_knowledge.desc: Capstone: table offers can roll one level above their vanilla cap.
